## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. -->

**Type of change**

- [ ] New newsletter issue, or edits to an unpublished issue
- [ ] Template change (`_quarto.yml`, `_extensions/` or `scripts/`), discussed in issue #
- [ ] Documentation or other

## For newsletter issues

**Issue file:** `issues/YYYY-MM-month.qmd`

**Source document:** <!-- e.g. 12-newsletter-december-2026.docx, or a link -->

**Changes from the source document**
<!-- Any wording, facts, dates or names you changed, so the author can check.
Write "None" if you copied it as written. -->

- [ ] Front matter filled in, with a preheader that describes this issue
- [ ] Images uploaded to Campaigner unedited, and referred to by their exact Campaigner file name (no folder, no address)
- [ ] Every image has alt text, including the key details of posters and banners
- [ ] Event dates written as `YYYY-MM-DD` and listed in date order
- [ ] Every image appears and every link works in the preview

## For template changes

**What looks or works differently, and why**

**Screenshots** <!-- Before and after, on desktop and phone. -->

- [ ] README updated, if the change affects how issues are written

## Before requesting review

- [ ] I rendered only the issue I worked on (`quarto render issues/<file>.qmd`), not the whole project
- [ ] The rendered output in `_output/` is committed and matches the source
- [ ] `git status` shows no changes to published issues or their output
- [ ] The render showed no warnings or errors
- [ ] Test email sent through Campaigner **after my last commit**, to me and my reviewer, and checked on desktop and phone
